title: The Exorcist
author: William Peter Blatty
summary: When strange things start happening to the young daughter of an actress living in Georgetown, doctors cannot find a cause. A troubled priest who has lost his faith is eventually called in.
readIf: you want a serious, slow-building horror novel about faith and doubt with a real sense of dread.
skipIf: you can't take disturbing, graphic scenes involving a child.

pairings.reason: Another 1960s-70s horror classic about evil closing in on a domestic life, quieter and creepier.
Another horror novel about a family and a presence that wears down the people in it.
A small-town horror about spreading evil, with a similar faith-versus-darkness theme.
